typed_original.task: Fresh synthetic two-turn pure echo interoperability; no shell/files/network tool effects

typed_json_guidance.condition: same synthetic task with explicit strict-JSON system guidance
typed_json_guidance.error: HTTP 400: {"error": {"message": "Incomplete or malformed MiniCPM call", "type": "invalid_request_error", "param": null, "code": null}}

string_only.condition: separate string-only CDATA two-turn baseline; typed-object failures retained

observed_typed_failure: Nested object emitted as Python representation with single-quoted keys, True and None; strict parser refused before any tool action
string_success_scope: One actual two-turn string/CDATA echo call, exact argument bytes, real tool result, exact final receipt, natural stops
missing_evidence: Original first HTTP400 response body not captured; status and original native snapshots retained
Raw HTTP request serialization bytes not captured; exact request field values and native consumed token histories retained
limitations: Two variants of one typed case and one string-only case are not a population benchmark
String-only success does not qualify arbitrary typed arguments or complete harness quality
Standard compatibility API idempotence/recovery/cancellation receipts are not qualified by this check
No model training or promotion; malformed output is not silently repaired

Pinned upstream MiniCPM tool path can enforce a schema grammar; this probe used no grammar. A matched constrained rerun is needed before attributing syntax failures solely to weights or comparing harnesses.

native_grammar_source_comparison.source_observation: Native MiniCPM parser builds a schema grammar when tools exist and tool_choice is not none; auto is lazy-triggered at <function, required immediate.
native_grammar_source_comparison.scope: Source inspection only; no matched constrained model rerun performed. Do not attribute measured typed failure solely to weights or compare it as an equivalent native-harness test.
